newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Abducted Japanese in Philippines freed-radio.
newsitem.headline: Abducted Japanese in Philippines freed-radio.

text.p: A Japanese businessman kidnapped in the southern Philippines has been freed, a local government employee told Reuters on Monday.

"We monitored on VHF police radio that the Japanese was released 45 minutes ago," said Joel Lozano, whose job is to monitor radio transmissions in the General Santos city area. The city is near Sarangani island where Kenichi Takayama and five Filipinos were abducted on Sunday.
